One forward pass gives the daily counts and, from each place's aggregate row, the 7-day sums or weekly targets.
Ebola: two passes per nowcast date, the active block and one block per province, to fit in GPU memory.
Ebola only: draws paired across places by a copula for the hub's trajectories, with the alternatives in the SI.
Checkpoints of the models fine-tuned on simulations are scored on the validation simulations and the German development half (SI).
